expected_hot_path: Broad-filter scratch storage across every top-candidate sort, compatible-radius scan, and final candidate materialization in all 50 timed events.
falsifier: The timing prediction fails unless the candidate is confidently faster under the fixed campaign Genesis envelope; any stale scratch value, changed candidate index, compatible radius, sorted candidate, seed, event hash, ordered diagnostic, exact collector count, unmasked FPE, crash, or private loaded-closure change falsifies the lifecycle and physics invariants.
hypothesis: Retaining the BroadTripletSeedFilter Cache as thread-local scratch across events will preserve all per-operation clear, resize, iota, and overwrite semantics while avoiding repeated release and regrowth of its three vectors during each timed event.
novelty_reason: No continuous owned-static revision-2 slot has retained the complete broad-filter cache across events. Slot 61 changed only compatible-radius representation, slot 82 retained only grid neighbor-range vectors, and the pinned Grid algorithm already uses the analogous TripletSeeder Cache as thread-local cross-event scratch while recreating BroadTripletSeedFilter Cache per event.

BroadTripletSeedFilter State, candidate collector, quality map, and filter object remain event-local and unchanged
the cache remains thread-local, preserving independent scratch storage for every execution thread and algorithm call sequence
all 50 ordered input event hashes remain exact
selected and matched particle counts remain exact
converted, matched, fake, and duplicate track counts remain exact
